CLANG FULL BUILD
clang -std=c89 -pedantic -Wall -Wextra -Werror -O2 -Iinclude -c src/re3_codec.c -o re3_codec.o
ar rcs libre3_codec.a re3_codec.o
clang -std=c89 -pedantic -Wall -Wextra -Werror -O2 -Iinclude tools/re3emd_info.c libre3_codec.a -o re3emd_info
clang -std=c89 -pedantic -Wall -Wextra -Werror -O2 -Iinclude tools/re3emd_viewer.c libre3_codec.a -o re3emd_viewer
clang -std=c89 -pedantic -Wall -Wextra -Werror -O2 -Iinclude tools/re3emd_parts.c libre3_codec.a -o re3emd_parts
clang -std=c89 -pedantic -Wall -Wextra -Werror -O2 -Iinclude tools/re3emd_morph.c libre3_codec.a -o re3emd_morph
clang -std=c89 -pedantic -Wall -Wextra -Werror -O2 -Iinclude tests/test_synthetic.c libre3_codec.a -o test_synthetic
clang -std=c89 -pedantic -Wall -Wextra -Werror -O2 -Iinclude tests/test_tim.c libre3_codec.a -o test_tim
clang -std=c89 -pedantic -Wall -Wextra -Werror -O2 -Iinclude tests/test_key_resolution.c libre3_codec.a -o test_key_resolution
clang -std=c89 -pedantic -Wall -Wextra -Werror -O2 -Iinclude tests/test_texture_binding.c libre3_codec.a -o test_texture_binding

CLANG TEST
./test_synthetic

./test_tim
